description:
Featuring the ENVE In-Route System, the Paramo Integrated offers seamless integration. However, the integration goes beyond cable routing, accommodating wider tires and incorporating fork mounts as standard, T47 bottom bracket, and UDH dropouts.

Handcrafted with precision in El Retiro, Colombia, each Páramo frameset is meticulously built in-house using the finest materials and techniques. This one-by-one approach ensures every bike is custom-tuned to match your riding style and needs, delivering exceptional ride quality, durability, and performance.

"Inspired by one of the most fascinating landscapes - the Páramo. This unique ecosystem is not only spectacular but also enigmatic. Its high elevation, continuous precipitation, precarious roads, and relentless winds create the perfect proving ground for our gravel-specific frameset. Built to thrive in the most demanding conditions, the Páramo is ready for wherever the adventure leads."

components.description: Wolf Tooth headset matching the selected variant.
Every frameset comes with a small set of touchup paint and framesaver.
